thread:
maya liu: Heads-up: contractor -> FTE conversion for APAC contractor who is relocating to US. Hiring manager requests provisional compband uplift (to align with internal peers) + retroactive equity proration and PTO accrual from start date. Need comp, finance, and payroll alignment before offer goes live.

maya liu: Offer snapshot:
```
Role: Senior Platform Eng (US)
Base: USD 165,000 (requested uplift from Band 4C -> 4D provisional for 9 months)
Sign-on: USD 15,000 split: 50% on first payroll, 50% after 6 months
Equity: 0.12% (request to prorate and backdate vesting start to contractor hire date)
Requested start: 2026-06-01 (candidate relocating from SG -> CA; payroll entity: Redwood US Inc)
```

omar hassan: Important Qs: 1) Are there any local pre-employment payments that would trigger double-tax? 2) Contractor pay history will affect year-to-date withholding — payroll will need gross-up guidance.

maya liu: Contractor was paid through a third-party contractor agency in SG. Manager wants equity start date to reflect original engagement (2025-09-15) as retention signal.

riley park: Comp committee note: provisional uplift > band threshold requires comp chair + finance signoff. For equity backdating we need legal signoff and EOR/contractor conversion docs. Also PTO accrual retroactive to contractor start is unusual — needs policy exception.

sasha kovalenko: Payroll/finance: cross-border conversion flags: 1) retroactive salary differentials may create tax withholding gaps in US and SG; 2) equity backdating affects 83(b) window and potential tax elections; 3) splitting sign-on across payrolls is doable but needs GL mapping and a one-off tax calc. We need a tax equalization proposal and confirmation of entity change date.

people-ops-bot: Routing to comp-committee for "Provisional Band Uplift + Conversion Exceptions". Please attach manager justification, contractor history, and proposed rollback timeline.

omar hassan: I'll coordinate with tax counsel about SG withholding and US grossing options. We should propose either: (A) gross-up the retro pay to cover US withholding, or (B) issue a net make-whole and document candidate tax responsibility. Which does hiring prefer?

maya liu: Hiring manager prefers gross-up to avoid candidate bearing unexpected tax. Manager also agreed to a 9-month provisional uplift review at month 8.

riley park: I'll add to comp committee agenda for 05/20. Required materials: manager justification memo, proposed rollback language, legal signoff for equity backdate, tax counsel note. If comp approves, HR can process retro PTO accrual as an exception but need payroll confirmation of accrual dates.

sasha kovalenko: Finance actions: compute YTD withholding impact across SG->US, GL codes for split sign-on, estimate employer-side taxes for retroactive payouts. If comp approves we need 7 business days to prepare payroll entries.

maya liu: Uploaded docs: https://redwood.share/people-ops/docs/convert-4098765432-manager-memo (private). Candidate requests decision by next Wed.

people-ops-bot: Actions logged: [Maya] attach contractor pay records, [Omar] tax counsel note, [Sasha] GL + withholding estimate, [Riley] comp agenda 05/20, [Comp-Committee] decision by 05/22. :calendar:
